data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.source:
Come on! What's wrong with you?
Staring off into space like that...
data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.target:
真是的！你怎么了？
一直在这里发呆……

data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.source:
What? Me? What are you talking about?
I'm \c[51]Memoria\c[0]. I'm here to assist you!
data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.target:
什么？我？你在说什么呀？
我是\c[51]梅莫莉娅\c[0]，是来帮助你的！

data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.source: Really, what's up with you? Are you okay?

Er, whatever, we have to go!
The \c[52]light\c[0] is right behind us!
Hurry, let's run \i[7500]\my[-2]!
data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.target:
算了，快走吧！
\c[52]光\c[0]就在我们身后！
快往\i[7500]\my[-2]跑！

data/event/mes/tutorial/tu001c01/tu001c0.source:
The \c[52]light\c[0] approaches from the \c[52]left\c[0]
side of the screen. To avoid being
swallowed by the \c[52]light\c[0], escape \my[-5]\i[7500]\my[-5].
